title: Thromok — Square Meal
summary: Feed token meals into devour enters, especially Thromok's N-squared counters, then connect or Fling the leftover giant.

tags.name: +1/+1 counters
tags.reason: Every devourer converts meals into counters; Thromok is quadratic.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: The 99 exists to print bodies that devourers eat.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Devour, Greater Good, Gargadon, Siege-Gang, High Market, and Clamp all spend creatures.

tags.name: stompy
tags.reason: Wins are oversized creatures connecting or Flung.

tags.name: aristocrats
tags.reason: Death payoffs (Vengeance, Fecundity, Marshal) sit under the devour plan.

tags.name: goblins
tags.reason: A dedicated goblin meal package plus Voracious Dragon.

tags.name: saprolings
tags.reason: Mycoloth, Burst, Sprout Swarm, and Thallid Devourer.

tags.name: aggro
tags.reason: Haste swallows exist; the deck still sets a board first.

tags.name: dragons
tags.reason: Several devour dragons, not a dragon tribal deck.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: Token midrange into a big turn, not a fair value grind as the identity.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Thromok can commander-damage, but other eaters also close.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Sabertooth and Portal re-enter devourers; not a blink deck.
